title: ProspectingAgentDataSource - Data API
description: Represents a Prospecting Agent data source.

Priority.description: The priority value for the source. A lower number indicates a higher priority.

ProspectingAgentSpecId.description: A reference to the parent ProspectingAgentSpecification.

SourceId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
SourceId.description: The ID associated with the Salesforce report this agent is using to generate prospects. If the agent is not using a Salesforce report, this value is null.

SourceType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
SourceType.description: The category of the source the agent is referencing. Possible values are: Report ZoomInfo

special_access_rules: This object is available if Agentforce Prospecting is enabled in your org and your org has an Agentforce for Sales or an Agentforce for an Industry add-on license. To access this object, you need the Sales Agentic Prospecting Manager user permission.
